validation.note: Single mesh, 16968 triangles per poly.pizza's listed Tris count (rounded pip geometry rather than a flat decal, hence the high tri count for a die). Bounding box near-cubic (100x100x100 units) and near-origin -- consistent with a normal die at cm scale, no corruption. Visually inspected via poly.pizza's rendered thumbnail before download: white die body, clear red circular pips, standard 1-6 pip layout legible on the visible faces -- passes this wave's pip-clarity bar (task explicitly warns against 'a decorative dice skin with no pip clarity').

reviewNote: Thumbnail-inspected for pip clarity before downloading (see validation note) but not yet opened in-engine/in a 3D viewer post-download or screenshotted from the actual .glb. Do not treat as visually approved.
